reproduction_target: De novo VGP-style genome assembly and annotation of Onychomys arenicola, O. leucogaster and Peromyscus eremicus (plus improved O. torridus assembly), construction of an Onychomys minigraph pangenome and structural-variation/most-variable-loci analysis, comparative synteny (minimap2/SyRI/plotsr), OrthoFinder/ClustalO/PAL2NAL/IQ-TREE2/PAML positive-selection scan across 14 murid proteomes, Illumina population resequencing (BWA-mem2 + bcftools 1.16) and a beetle-spray-exposure RNA-seq differential-expression analysis (STAR-featureCounts-DESeq2). Physical animal trapping, spray-exposure experiments, DNA/RNA extraction and PacBio HiFi / Arima Hi-C / Illumina sequencing are wet-lab (W, out of scope for computational reproduction).
granularity_note: Coarse one-step-per-named-tool/analysis, derived from the bioRxiv v1 full-text Methods prose. The JATS source XML returned HTTP 403 and the landing page HTTP 429; the v1.full HTML was retrieved by curl with a browser user-agent after rate-limit backoff, and the Materials and Methods + Data Availability sections were read in full. The paper has NO Code Availability section and names NO author code repository; the only two GitHub URLs in the text (github.com/ArimaGenomics/CHiC, github.com/lh3/gfatools) are third-party tool repositories, not the authors' analysis code, so there was no README prose to read. Two analyses explicitly rely on unreleased in-house code ('A custom Python script identified divergence-based loci', 'we developed a script that generated a table listing the gene names under positive selection'). Steps whose essential input or record is unobtainable are marked X: C5 (interactive PretextView manual curation, no edit log), C27/C28 (RNA-seq reads are not covered by any stated accession — Data Availability names only the genome sequencing reads and assemblies under PRJEB60916). Wet-lab steps counted in W, not verdicted.

steps.label: Contig assembly of PacBio HiFi reads with Hifiasm (VGP pipeline) — no version, no parameters given
Assembly QC with assembly-stats, BUSCO and Merqury — no versions, no lineage/kmer settings given
Haplotig and false-overlap removal with purge_dups — no version, no cutoffs given
Hi-C scaffolding with Salsa2 and YaHS (YaHS scaffolds retained) — no versions, no parameters
Manual curation round: Arima CHiC pipeline (github.com/ArimaGenomics/CHiC) + PretextMap + interactive PretextView editing to fix misassemblies, detect inversions and anchor contigs
Chromosome assignment by whole-genome alignment to O. torridus GCA_903995425.1 (and P. leucopus for P. eremicus) with MUMmer4, visualised with Gnuplot — no versions, no alignment parameters
DNA contamination screen with FCS-GX (NCBI Foreign Contamination Screen suite) — no version, no database release given
Repeat annotation with RepeatMasker v4.1.4 + rmblastn v2.11.0+ against the Dfam 3.6 database, query species assumed rodent; repeat abundances extracted from the .tbl output

Gene annotation with the Ensembl Gene Annotation pipeline (ENA short-read transcriptomes + UniProt mammalian SwissProt + GENCODE mouse CDS via pairwise alignment; model classification into protein-coding/pseudogene/lncRNA)
Non-coding RNA annotation: miRBase alignment + RNAfold secondary-structure analysis for miRNAs; Rfam + Infernal for other small ncRNAs — no versions or database releases

Gene-name transfer from previous NCBI annotations to Ensembl annotations with Liftoff + Bedtools intersect, five rounds decreasing -f from 0.9 to 0.1 in 0.2 steps, unmatched genes carried forward; converted to Mus musculus orthologs
Pairwise alignment of O. torridus (GCA_949787125.1) and P. eremicus (GCA_949786415.1) with Minimap2 -asm10 — version not pinned
Synteny-break detection with SyRI and visualisation with plotsr — no versions, no parameters
Onychomys pangenome construction with Minigraph (O. torridus as reference backbone; O. arenicola and O. leucogaster aligned with default parameters) — version not pinned
Structural-variation calling from the minigraph graph with gfatools (github.com/lh3/gfatools) and CIRCOS histogram visualisation (Y-axis scaled 800 bp to 200 kbp) — no versions

Most-variable-loci detection: filter minigraph species BED to columns 1,2,3,8; 200 kb / 10 kb sliding-window BED over the O. torridus backbone; bedtools map; custom (unreleased) Python script defining loci at >50% consecutive-window divergence difference; top 5% windows retained; bedtools intersect -f 1 to extract fully overlapping genes

Orthology inference with OrthoFinder over the proteomes of 14 mouse species from Ensembl (Supplementary Table 6); one-to-one orthologs present in at least 13 species retained — no version, no Ensembl release
Protein multiple-sequence alignment with ClustalO — no version, no parameters
Codon alignment generation with PAL2NAL from transcript sequences + protein alignments, gaps filtered out — version not pinned
Phylogenetic tree construction from PAL2NAL alignments with IQ-TREE2 — no version, no model/bootstrap settings

Positive-selection detection with PAML followed by Benjamini-Hochberg correction; custom (unreleased) script tabulating gene names, alignment lengths and BEB-selected sites with probability >0.95; manual removal of genes with consecutive selected stretches or terminal selected sites
Validation re-run of codeml on candidate genes using the four-fold degenerate-site species tree (no additional multiple-testing correction applied) — no version, no control-file settings

Alignment of Illumina population resequencing data (22 O. torridus, 10 O. arenicola, 4 O. leucogaster, 11 P. eremicus) against the reference genomes with BWA-mem2, duplicates marked with Samtools markdup — no versions, no parameters
Alignment QC with Samtools stats (Supplementary Table 8; three samples failed QC) — no version, no pass/fail thresholds stated
Sample-labelling check: Scn4a sequence comparison across all samples and phylogenetic tree with IQ-TREE + FigTree (Figure 8) — no versions, no model settings
Variant calling with Bcftools 1.16 — version pinned, but no mpileup/call parameters or filtering thresholds given

RNA-seq read mapping to the genomes with STAR (trigeminal ganglia + DRG from O. torridus, P. eremicus, M. m. domesticus; 5 spray-exposed vs 5 control per species), QC with Samtools stats (Supplementary Table 9) — no version, no parameters, and no accession for the RNA-seq reads
Differential gene expression with the STAR-featureCounts-DESeq2 pipeline — no versions, no design formula, no significance thresholds, and no accession for the underlying RNA-seq reads

headline.static_readiness: 0/28 (0%) — stage1 ceiling only, no R★ (R★ needs stage-2 code verification)
headline.inference_inclusive_upper_bound: RI ceiling on 1/28 computational steps (C8 RepeatMasker v4.1.4 / rmblastn v2.11.0+ / Dfam 3.6, the only step with both an exact version pin and stated parameters). 24/28 steps cap at NI, almost entirely because no software version is pinned anywhere else in the Methods — the only other exact pin in the paper is Bcftools 1.16 (C26), which still caps at NI because no calling or filtering parameters are given. 3/28 steps are X: C5 is an interactive PretextView manual-curation round with no recorded edit history, and C27/C28 depend on RNA-seq reads for which no accession is stated anywhere (Data Availability covers only the genome sequencing reads and assemblies under PRJEB60916). No author code repository, container, conda spec or lockfile is claimed anywhere in the paper, and two analyses depend on explicitly custom, unreleased scripts, so even under stage2 no step can exceed RI.
headline.coverage: 28 computational steps assessed from the bioRxiv v1 full-text Materials and Methods prose (assembly, curation, annotation, pangenome, comparative/selection analyses, population resequencing, RNA-seq DGE). 8 wet-lab/physical steps (animal trapping and IACUC-approved husbandry, Qiagen DNeasy DNA extraction, PacBio HiFi library + sequencing, Arima Hi-C library, Illumina WGS library + sequencing, darkling-beetle spray collection and facial-spray exposure experiment, tissue harvest of trigeminal/dorsal root ganglia, Trizol mRNA extraction + RNA-seq library prep) counted in W and out of computational-reproduction scope.

gaps.missing: There is no Code Availability section and no author code repository (GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket/Zenodo/Software Heritage) named anywhere. The only two GitHub URLs in the text are third-party tool repositories (github.com/ArimaGenomics/CHiC, github.com/lh3/gfatools). No pipeline definition, command set, or configuration for any of the 28 computational steps is deposited.
gaps.how_to_close: Publish the assembly/annotation/pangenome/selection/RNA-seq command sets and driver scripts in a public repository with an archived, citable snapshot (Zenodo DOI or Software Heritage identifier), and add a Code Availability statement pointing to it.

gaps.where: Custom in-house scripts (C16 most-variable-loci detection, C21 positive-selection candidate tabulation)
gaps.missing: Two analyses explicitly depend on unshared custom code: 'A custom Python script identified divergence-based loci by comparing consecutive windows' (C16) and 'we developed a script that generated a table listing the gene names under positive selection, alignment lengths, and the amino acids positively selected based on a Bayes Empirical Bayes (BEB) analysis' (C21). Neither script is deposited; only prose descriptions exist.
gaps.how_to_close: Release both scripts with their exact invocation and default/used threshold values (e.g. the 50% divergence-difference threshold, the top-5% window cutoff, the BEB probability cutoff).

gaps.where: Nearly all tool invocations (C1-C7, C9-C25, C27-C28)
gaps.missing: Only two exact software pins appear in the entire Methods: RepeatMasker v4.1.4 (with rmblastn v2.11.0+ and Dfam 3.6) and Bcftools 1.16. Hifiasm, BUSCO, Merqury, assembly-stats, purge_dups, Salsa2, YaHS, MUMmer4, FCS-GX, Liftoff, Bedtools, Minimap2, SyRI, plotsr, Minigraph, gfatools, CIRCOS, OrthoFinder, ClustalO, PAL2NAL, IQ-TREE2, PAML/codeml, BWA-mem2, Samtools, STAR, featureCounts, DESeq2, FigTree, RNAfold and Infernal all carry no version. Database releases for FCS-GX, miRBase, Rfam, GENCODE, UniProt SwissProt and the Ensembl proteome set are likewise unpinned (Dfam 3.6 is the sole exception).
gaps.how_to_close: Add a software/database versions table listing every tool and reference database with its exact version or release, or emit a versions report from the workflow manager.

gaps.missing: No environment capture of any kind is claimed: no container image or digest, no conda/mamba environment file, no lockfile, no workflow-manager (Nextflow/Snakemake/WDL/CWL) definition. The VGP pipeline and the Ensembl Gene Annotation pipeline are cited by name only, with no pipeline version or revision hash.
gaps.how_to_close: Provide a container digest or a conda-lock/pixi lockfile covering the assembly, annotation, comparative-genomics and RNA-seq stacks, and pin the VGP and Ensembl annotation pipeline releases used.

gaps.where: Parameters and thresholds across most steps
gaps.missing: Parameters are given only for a handful of steps (Bedtools -f 0.9 to 0.1 in five rounds; minimap2 -asm10; 200 kb/10 kb windows with a 50% divergence threshold and top-5% cutoff; bedtools intersect -f 1; BEB > 0.95; RepeatMasker rodent query; ortholog presence in >=13 of 14 species). Command lines are absent for hifiasm, BUSCO/Merqury, purge_dups, Salsa2/YaHS, MUMmer4, FCS-GX, ClustalO, IQ-TREE2 (model/bootstrap), PAML (codeml control files, site/branch-site model choice), BWA-mem2, bcftools mpileup/call and filtering, STAR, featureCounts and DESeq2 (design formula, significance thresholds, shrinkage). The 'user-defined threshold (default: 50%)' in C16 is not stated as the value actually used.
gaps.how_to_close: Publish the exact command lines / codeml control files / DESeq2 design and thresholds used, and state the actually-used value wherever a parameter is described only as a default.

gaps.where: RNA-seq data (C27, C28) and annotation inputs
gaps.missing: The Data Availability statement covers only 'the genome sequencing reads and the genome assemblies' under ENA project PRJEB60916. No accession is given for the beetle-spray exposure RNA-seq reads (10 individuals x 3 species, trigeminal ganglia and DRG) used for the STAR-featureCounts-DESeq2 analysis, nor for the Illumina population resequencing reads of the 47 individuals, nor for the ENA short-read transcriptomes used as Ensembl annotation evidence (described only as 'sourced from the European Nucleotide Archive'). Supplementary tables are cited for sample lists but no per-sample run accessions are stated in the main text.
gaps.how_to_close: Deposit the RNA-seq and population resequencing reads and list per-sample run accessions (or a single umbrella project accession explicitly stated to cover them), and give the exact ENA run accessions of the transcriptomic evidence used by the annotation pipeline.

gaps.where: C5 manual Hi-C curation (PretextView) and C25 FigTree visualisation
gaps.missing: The curation round is an interactive desktop-GUI operation ('a desktop application for viewing and editing HiC contact maps') used to fix misassemblies, detect inversions and anchor contigs. No edit log, AGP diff, or record of the manual operations is provided, so this step cannot be re-executed. FigTree is likewise an interactive viewer.
gaps.how_to_close: Deposit the pre- and post-curation assemblies together with the curation AGP / Pretext edit log so the manual interventions are auditable even if not re-executable.

gaps.missing: Because no author repository exists, there is no archived snapshot, no DOI, and no software licence for any of the analysis code.
gaps.how_to_close: Create the repository, apply an OSI-approved licence, and archive a tagged release to Zenodo with a DOI cited in the manuscript.

gaps.missing: Animal trapping in AZ/NM/KS under IACUC protocols, isoflurane euthanasia and tissue harvest, Qiagen DNeasy DNA extraction, PacBio HiFi library prep + sequencing, Arima Hi-C library prep, Illumina WGS library prep + sequencing, darkling-beetle (Eleodes longicollus) spray collection and anesthetised facial-spray exposure experiment, Trizol mRNA extraction and RNA-seq library prep. These are physical data-generation steps, out of scope for computational reproduction; counted in W and not verdicted.
gaps.how_to_close: N/A for Tier-1 computational readiness; the ENA-deposited reads and assemblies (PRJEB60916) are the intended reproducible entry point for the genome-side analyses.
